title.value: Knowledge Distillation for Federated Learning: A Practical Guide
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned in the abstract and throughout the paper.
title.quote: Knowledge Distillation for Federated Learning: a Practical Guide

extractions.description: The paper reviews knowledge distillation (KD) methods applied to federated learning (FL), offering a comprehensive guide on solving specific challenges in FL using KD, such as model and data heterogeneity. It surveys existing KD-based FL strategies to address the limitations of parameter-averaging FL schemes, focusing on enabling model heterogeneity and mitigating client drift through various KD techniques.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper does not address climate or ecologically-related sustainable development. It primarily focuses on federated learning methodologies and technical challenges associated with knowledge distillation.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Federated Learning (FL) enables the training of Deep Learning models without centrally collecting possibly sensitive raw data. This paves the way for stronger privacy guarantees when building predictive models.

primary_category.justification: There is no central focus on any climate or ecologically-related sustainable development category. The paper is technical and focuses on data privacy, model distillation, and federated learning.
primary_category.quote: In this article, we provide a review of KD-based algorithms tailored for specific FL issues.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not address any other climate or ecologically-related sustainable development themes.
secondary_categories.quote: Federated Learning (FL) has been proposed as an alternative to cloud-based Deep Learning (DL). This paradigm decouples the ability to train DL models from the need of harvesting raw data.

primary_sub_category.quote: Federated Averaging (FedAvg) represents the baseline algorithm for Federated Learning (FL).
